hook: Training a language model begins long before the first forward pass. The corpus has to land on disk, decompressed, deduplicated, and addressable, with the resume story already worked out before the network drops at 4 percent. This lesson builds a streaming downloader that pulls compressed shards, decompresses on the fly with Zstandard, fingerprints near-duplicates via MinHash plus locality-sensitive hashing, and writes a shard manifest the rest of the pipeline can trust.
